notes: enabled=false: the publisher only previews. The EN autopilot workflow sets enabled=true itself once VI-EN Core 0.5.1 is installed and its rollout pass verified (routes live, categories registered, page pairs linked, English pages public); the publisher re-checks routes and categories through nh-vien/v1/status before any write. page_pairs are the Vietnamese pages with a true English equivalent (hreflang); the rollout checks both slugs before it links a pair. mode=pilot publishes only pilot_ids; mode=batch publishes every QA-ready article in batches of batch_size, max_batches_per_run per run. Advance 3 -> 10 -> 20 only after the previous batch verified live.
